notes: Design is not named; cross-sectional inferred from a single year of claims-based prescriber data. Imputing 10 beneficiaries for suppressed counts is a single fixed fill-in (data cleaning), and the top-10% cutoff is quantization; neither is recorded as a procedure. Medians of prescriber-level rates compared by Wilcoxon could also support a continuous outcome reading.
